sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows 2376 ppm defects (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 45.15 per unit (po:4500014429-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014306-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Hi, thanks for the info. We can do the 300 ppm you want, but to keep quality that tight we need EUR 46.00 per unit. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

So our offer is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

why.tactician: The supplier has not moved in four rounds. Our steps upward did not shift it, and it states it needs a concession we cannot give, because payment and volume are fixed. E0 and o2–o5 are all worth less to it than its own sheet, so it will most likely restate €45.50. A gamble on ppm or chargeback trades away quality, which matters because our goal is quality_first. o6 saves very little over accepting and adds a chargeback clause it may resist. Further holding wastes rounds and risks a final_offer or walk-away, which would cost far more than the remaining gap. Offer 70140-5 has the best quality terms at a C of about €750k, well below the €894k no-deal cost, so we close now.
